pattern: Weapon frame layout for the Ninja Adventure pack. Two systems: (1) Items/Weapons/<Name>/ blade icons, (2) CharacterAnimated/Weapon/<Name>.png overlay atlases (legacy). AKARI bakes body+blade only — no FX layer.

hands_catalog.coverage: 304 occupied cells — CharacterAnimated 32px SpriteSheet 8×17 (122) + all 12 Separate sheets (122), plus Character 16px SpriteSheet 4×7 + all SeparateAnim (60)
hands_catalog.use: Every cell lists hand/foot mitt clusters + sword_grip. Katana seating MUST use separate.Attack[dir][frame].sword_grip — never invent coordinates.

blade_icon.orientation: tip DOWN — orange wrap at TOP is the grip (NOT inventory Sprite.png which is tip-UP)
blade_icon.use: Orange wrap seated at ninja_green_hands.json Attack[dir][frame].sword_grip.

overlay_atlas.note: Legacy static crescents — NOT used by Akari
